title: Selberg and Brolin on value distribution of complex dynamics
summary: The Brolin-Lyubich-Freire--Lopes--Mañé equidistribution theorem for iterated preimages of a given non-exceptional value and Lyubich's periodic point version of it are foundational in the study of dynamics of rational functions of degree more than one on the complex projective line, and Drasin and the author studied a quantification of the former in a formalism of Nevanlinna theory, or more specifically, with the aid of Selberg's theorem from covering theory.
